verses.kjv: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

verses.ar: «ٱلسُّلْطَانُ وَٱلْهَيْبَةُ عِنْدَهُ. هُوَ صَانِعُ ٱلسَّلَامِ فِي أَعَالِيهِ.
verses.kjv: Dominion and fear [are] with him, he maketh peace in his high places.
verses.web: “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.

verses.ar: هَلْ مِنْ عَدَدٍ لِجُنُودِهِ؟ وَعَلَى مَنْ لَا يُشْرِقُ نُورُهُ؟
verses.kjv: Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom doth not his light arise?
verses.web: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?

verses.ar: فَكَيْفَ يَتَبَرَّرُ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ عِنْدَ ٱللهِ؟ وَكَيْفَ يَزْكُو مَوْلُودُ ٱلْمَرْأَةِ؟
verses.kjv: How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean [that is] born of a woman?
verses.web: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?

verses.ar: هُوَذَا نَفْسُ ٱلْقَمَرِ لَا يُضِيءُ، وَٱلْكَوَاكِبُ غَيْرُ نَقِيَّةٍ فِي عَيْنَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.
verses.web: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;

verses.ar: فَكَمْ بِٱلْحَرِيِّ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ ٱلرِّمَّةُ، وَٱبْنُ آدَمَ ٱلدُّودُ؟».
verses.kjv: How much less man, [that is] a worm? and the son of man, [which is] a worm?
verses.web: How much less man, who is a worm, and the son of man, who is a worm!”
